<function name="GetHideButtons" parent="DVScrollBar" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns whether or not the manual up/down scroll buttons are visible or not. Set by <page>DVScrollBar:SetHideButtons</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether or not the manual up/down scroll buttons are visible or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
